product_overview: Inflero is a bilingual, Arabic-first web app for managing the full operational workflow of an influencer brand-deal business. It centralizes authentication, brand and deal tracking, payments, meetings, Snap analytics, reporting, and subscription billing in one mobile-first dashboard.
core_goals: Let new users sign up, complete their profile, and begin managing their own data quickly
Provide a complete brand-deal lifecycle from brand setup through deal progress, payment collection, and reporting
Support Arabic and English with full RTL/LTR behavior, Hijri and Gregorian dates, and SAR currency formatting
Keep all user data isolated per tenant through authentication, client route protection, and server-side RLS
Help users stay on top of today’s work with dashboard totals, reminders, and attention signals
Enable Pro-gated Snap analytics extraction, reports, and web push features with entitlement enforcement
Support atomic, reliable payment updates and accurate status synchronization across deals and payments

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Lets users log in with Google OAuth or email/password, verifies email sign-up, creates the initial profile row on first login, and routes users to the correct page based on session state.
user_flows: GET /login to open the login page -> Submit valid Google OAuth login -> GET /auth-callback to complete the callback -> Receive authenticated session and route to /dashboard
GET /login to open the login page -> Submit invalid email/password credentials -> Receive authentication error and remain on /login
GET /auth-callback after email verification -> Session is established -> Protected app routes become accessible
GET /dashboard without a valid session -> Request is blocked by protected routing and server-side access control -> Redirect to /login

features.name: Public Landing Page
features.description: Shows a bilingual public marketing page for logged-out visitors, with Arabic/English toggle support and RTL-aware layout.
user_flows: GET / while logged out -> Receive the public landing page in the selected language and direction
GET / while logged out -> Toggle language from English to Arabic -> Page re-renders in RTL with Arabic copy
GET /dashboard while logged out -> Access is blocked because the app routes are protected -> Redirect to /login or public entry flow
GET / with an invalid or unsupported locale state -> Default landing page renders with the fallback language and layout

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Provides the authenticated home view with current-month financial totals, today’s worklist, attention alerts, trend visualization, and profile-completion guidance.
user_flows: GET /dashboard with a valid session -> Load authenticated dashboard data -> Display current-month totals, today items, needs-attention cards, and profile banner state
GET /dashboard with incomplete profile data -> Dashboard loads -> Show incomplete profile banner with a prompt to complete settings
GET /dashboard with no overdue items or due work -> Dashboard loads -> Display all-clear empty states for today and attention panels
GET /dashboard without a valid session -> Request is rejected by protected access controls -> Redirect to /login

features.name: Brands
features.description: Lets users manage a bilingual brand directory and inspect brand-specific rollups such as lifetime value, average deal size, and last engagement.
user_flows: GET /brands with a valid session -> Receive the brand directory -> Add a new brand and then open /brands/:id to view its details and rollups
GET /brands -> Submit a brand form with missing required fields -> Receive validation errors and no brand is created
GET /brands/:id for an existing brand -> Receive brand detail data including related deals and rollup metrics
GET /brands/:id for a brand that does not exist or is not owned by the user -> Receive an access or not-found error

features.name: Ad Deals
features.description: Supports creating, editing, filtering, and expanding deals, while tracking deliverables, lifecycle checkpoints, payment status, and linked Snap reports.
user_flows: GET /deals with a valid session -> Receive the filtered deal list and money rollup -> Add a deal with valid brand, amounts, dates, and deliverables -> Deal appears in the list
GET /deals -> Submit a deal with invalid deliverables or negative amount -> Receive form validation errors and the deal is not saved
GET /deals -> Mark a deal as Shot then Posted through the deal row actions -> Deal status advances from pending to shot to posted and reminders update accordingly
GET /deals while on a free account with 5 in-flight deals -> Attempt to create another in-flight deal -> Receive an upgrade or limit error and the deal is not created
GET /deals/:id for a deal belonging to another tenant -> Access is denied by server-side row-level security

features.name: Payments
features.description: Manages pending and received payments, supports installments, sends reminders, and atomically updates the related deal when the final payment is received.
user_flows: GET /payments with a valid session -> Receive pending and received payment tabs -> Mark a pending installment as received -> Payment status updates and the related deal becomes paid if all installments are complete
GET /payments -> Mark the last outstanding installment as received -> Atomic transaction completes -> Payment is received and the deal status flips to paid together
GET /payments -> Send a reminder for a pending payment -> An in-app reminder is created for the user
GET /payments -> Submit an invalid payment action or unauthorized payment id -> Receive an error and no payment state changes are saved

features.name: Meetings and Reminders
features.description: Lets users create meetings, automatically schedules linked reminders, and keeps those reminders synchronized when meeting time changes or cancellations occur.
user_flows: GET /meetings with a valid session -> Receive the meetings calendar and list -> Create a meeting with title, time, and optional brand/deal link -> Meeting is created and an auto reminder is scheduled
GET /meetings -> Edit an existing meeting time -> Reminder due time is moved to match the new schedule
GET /meetings -> Cancel a meeting -> Meeting status updates to cancelled and its reminder is cleared
GET /meetings -> Submit a meeting form with missing required fields -> Receive validation errors and the meeting is not created

features.name: Snap Analytics
features.description: Allows Pro users to upload Snap screenshots or PDFs, run AI extraction, edit extracted fields, link reports to deals, and export branded PNG reports.
user_flows: GET /analytics/snap with a Pro entitlement -> Upload a valid Snap screenshot or PDF -> Receive a pending report, extraction runs, and the UI updates in realtime with extracted metrics
GET /analytics/snap with a Pro entitlement -> Upload a PDF file -> PDF is converted in-browser to PNG -> Image upload proceeds and extraction starts
GET /analytics/snap with a free entitlement -> Attempt to upload a Snap report -> Receive a Pro gate or upgrade modal and extraction does not start
GET /analytics/snap -> Extraction fails on a report -> User enters values manually -> Manual override is saved and remains the source of truth
GET /analytics/snap/:id or the snap detail sheet -> Link a post report to a deal and export a branded PNG -> Receive a downloadable image for sharing

features.name: Reports
features.description: Provides Pro-gated monthly invoiced-versus-collected charts and all-time per-brand reporting with collection-rate calculations.
user_flows: GET /reports with a Pro entitlement -> Receive the monthly chart and per-brand table -> Review collection rates and brand totals
GET /reports with a free entitlement -> Attempt to open the page -> Receive a Pro gate or upgrade modal instead of the full report
GET /reports -> View a brand with zero invoiced amount -> Collection rate displays as a safe placeholder instead of NaN or Infinity
GET /reports with incomplete or empty data -> Reports render with zero-filled months and empty-state-safe metrics

features.name: Settings and Profile
features.description: Lets users change language, reminder lead time, profile details, billing access, and sign out, with changes saved to the user profile record.
user_flows: GET /settings with a valid session -> Load current language, reminder, profile, and billing settings -> Update the locale and profile fields -> Save changes to the user profile row
GET /settings -> Upload an invalid avatar file or exceed the size limit -> Receive validation errors and the profile image is not saved
GET /settings -> Change reminder lead time -> Save the setting -> Future reminders use the new lead time while existing reminders remain unchanged
GET /settings -> Click sign out -> Session is cleared -> Subsequent access to protected pages redirects to /login

features.name: Subscription Billing
features.description: Handles Pro upgrades and billing management through hosted checkout and customer portal flows, and exposes entitlement changes once the webhook updates the backend.
user_flows: GET /settings as a free user -> Click Upgrade to Pro -> Hosted checkout starts and redirects away from the app
GET /settings?checkout=success after completing checkout -> Receive a processing state and entitlement refresh -> Pro access becomes available once the webhook update arrives
GET /settings as a Pro user -> Open Manage Billing -> Customer portal launch begins
GET /analytics/snap or /reports as a free user -> Attempt to use a Pro-gated feature -> Upgrade modal appears and blocks the action

features.name: App Shell and Navigation
features.description: Provides the protected in-app layout, including the top header, bottom tab bar, Quick Add sheet, profile menu, and direction-aware navigation behavior.
user_flows: GET /dashboard with a valid session -> App shell loads around the page -> User navigates via bottom tabs, profile menu, or Quick Add FAB sheet
GET /dashboard -> Open the Quick Add FAB sheet -> Choose Deal, Meeting, Payment, or Snap -> Navigate to the destination route and open that section’s add flow
GET /reports in Arabic locale -> App shell mirrors to RTL -> Navigation, tabs, and segmented controls render direction-aware
GET /dashboard without a session -> Protected shell is not rendered -> Redirect to /login

features.name: Internationalization and RTL
features.description: Delivers Arabic-first bilingual behavior, live RTL/LTR switching, Hijri and Gregorian date presentation, and locale-aware digit and currency formatting.
user_flows: GET /settings with a valid session -> Toggle language from Arabic to English -> App updates html dir/lang and all visible text re-renders in English
GET /dashboard in Arabic locale -> Dates and numbers render using Arabic-Indic digits and Hijri/Gregorian-aware formatting
GET /brands in Arabic locale -> UI direction switches to RTL -> Layout, spacing, and navigation mirror correctly
GET /settings -> Save a locale change -> Locale persists to the user profile and affects future sessions

features.name: Web Push Notifications
features.description: Lets Pro users manage web push subscriptions for reminder digests and install prompts as part of the paid reminder experience.
user_flows: GET /settings with a Pro entitlement -> Enable web push notifications -> Browser subscription is created and saved for the user
GET /settings with an active web push subscription -> Disable web push notifications -> Subscription is removed and reminders stop using push delivery
GET /settings with a free entitlement -> Attempt to enable web push -> Receive a Pro gate or upgrade modal
GET /settings -> Browser does not support install or push APIs -> Feature is unavailable and the UI shows the unsupported state

tech_stack: Supabase JS client (auth, Postgres/RLS, storage, realtime, edge functions)

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Google OAuth (PKCE) and email/password with email verification. Logged-in users are routed to the dashboard; logged-out users to login. First login bootstraps an app_users profile row. Protected routes are guarded client-side and enforced server-side by RLS.

endpoints.description: Login page (Google + email/password + sign-up toggle + verify notice)

features.name: Public Landing Page
features.description: Bilingual (EN/AR) marketing landing page at the root for logged-out visitors, isolated under a .lp-scoped stylesheet, mobile responsive with an EN/AR toggle and RTL.

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Current-month totals (invoiced, collected, outstanding, posted, pending), a Today worklist of meetings/reminders due in 24h with done/dismiss, a Needs-attention panel for overdue payments and past-due deals, an invoiced-trend sparkline, and an incomplete-profile banner.

features.name: Brands
features.description: Brand directory (bilingual names, contact, deal-count badge) with add/edit, and a brand detail page showing deals, lifetime total, average deal size, and last engagement.

features.name: Ad Deals
features.description: Deals list with brand/status/month filters and a money rollup. Rows expand to a deliverables descriptor, two lifecycle checkmarks (Shot/Posted, status derived pending to shot to posted to paid; cancel is manual), payment status, and a linked Snap report. Add/edit deal form. Free plan is capped at 5 in-flight deals (server trigger surfaces an upgrade prompt).

endpoints.description: Deals list, filters, add/edit, expandable rows

features.name: Payments
features.description: Pending and Received tabs (installments supported). Mark-as-received runs an atomic edge-function transaction that also flips the deal to paid when the last installment clears. Send-reminder drops an in-app reminder.

features.name: Meetings and Reminders
features.description: Month-grid calendar plus list view. Creating a meeting auto-creates a reminder at meeting time minus the user's lead time, feeding the dashboard Today panel. Editing the time moves the reminder; cancelling clears it.

features.name: Snap Analytics
features.description: Upload a Snap Insights screenshot or PDF (PDF converted to PNG in-browser). An edge function runs GPT-4o vision extraction (post or monthly report type); results stream back via realtime. Each field is editable (manual override wins). Failed extraction falls back to manual entry. A report can link to a deal and export as a branded PNG. Pro-gated.

endpoints.description: Snap upload, extraction history, detail sheet, PNG export

features.name: Reports
features.description: Monthly invoiced-vs-collected bar chart (last 12 months, RTL-tolerant) and an all-time per-brand table with collection rate. Pro-gated in the UI.

features.name: Settings and Profile
features.description: Language toggle (AR/EN, live RTL), reminder lead time, profile (display name + avatar upload), billing section, and sign-out. Form validated with zod and saved to app_users.

features.name: Subscription Billing
features.description: Free vs Pro plan. Upgrade starts a LemonSqueezy hosted checkout; entitlement flips to Pro via webhook then realtime. Manage-billing opens the customer portal. A single global Upgrade modal is the gate surface across Snap, Reports, and the deal limit.

endpoints.description: Post-checkout return; shows processing toast and refreshes entitlement

features.name: App Shell and Navigation
features.description: One protected layout route with a sticky avatar header, a bottom tab bar (Home, Deals, FAB, Calendar, Insights), a Quick Add 2x2 FAB sheet, a profile menu (Brands, Payments, Settings, Sign out), and an Insights segmented control. Direction-aware (mirrors in Arabic).

features.name: Internationalization and RTL
features.description: Arabic-first bilingual UI with full RTL, Hijri + Gregorian dual dates, SAR currency, and locale-aware (Arabic-Indic) digits. Locale toggle persists to app_users and flips html dir/lang.

features.name: Web Push Notifications
features.description: Install prompt and web-push subscription management for the twice-daily reminder digest (Pro feature, server cron).

known_limitations.issue: Entire app (except the landing page, login, and auth-callback) is behind authentication
known_limitations.impact: Automated tests must log in with email/password first; Google OAuth cannot be automated

known_limitations.issue: Pro features (Snap AI extraction, Reports, web-push) and the 5 in-flight deal limit are gated by entitlement
known_limitations.impact: A grandfathered/Pro test account will not trigger Free-tier gates (upgrade modal, deal cap); a brand-new account is needed to exercise the locked states

known_limitations.issue: App runs against the live Supabase backend, not a mock
known_limitations.impact: Tests create real rows (brands, deals, payments, meetings, snap reports) under the test account

known_limitations.issue: Checkout and customer portal redirect to LemonSqueezy (external, test mode)
known_limitations.impact: Full purchase flow leaves the app; tests can verify the redirect starts but not complete a real payment
